dataTransforms.description:
List of data transform types, which will be applied after the data is
received but before saving it in the state.

Constraint: These types must extend {@link UiSdlDataTransform}.

format.description: Specifies the format options of the param kind

valueType.description:
Specifies how to transform the extracted value. The default is string, but depending on the use case
it may be useful to transform the value to a value type like numbers, arrays, etc.

id.description: The id of the component to inspect

path.description:
The path from the root state of the `id` to the desired value.
Each level in the state should be traversed through a dot (.) delimiter.
Ex: 'c3arguments.arg1.field1'

action.description:
javascript action (expression) to perform on the state information.
References to the state path object can be made through 'statePathValue' variable.
The output of the action is expected to be stringifiable.

componentType.description: The type of the component specified by the `id`

stateType.description:
The state type to retrieve. Applicable when componentType = 'dataSource'.
`config` means the current data source configurations (ex: `c3arguments`)
`value` means the actual data of the data source

dataSpecField.description: The name of the field on the component in which the dataSpec is specified.
